diagnostics.title: Humidity sensor location
diagnostics.verdict_supply: Measured in the SUPPLY duct (after heat recovery / bypass)
diagnostics.warn_low_delta: Outdoor and supply temperatures are nearly equal — the bypass can barely perturb the supply air, so the run will probably be inconclusive. Run anyway?
diagnostics.hint_bypass_closed: The bypass stayed closed most of the window — check that it actually opened (the valve takes up to ~1 min). Some units refuse to hold the bypass open when outdoor air is warmer than indoor air; retry when outdoor < indoor.
